title: 麵攤收得比誰都晚
subject: 巷口麵攤的最後一碗
caption: Guofeng fusion mid-tempo pop. Pipa played inside the arrangement as a rhythm instrument rather than an exotic lead, modern tight drum kit with a dry clap layered on the snare, warm round electric bass, one sustained erhu line entering only on the last chorus. Mid-range male vocal, unforced, no melisma. 96 BPM, D minor. Steamy, blunted, ordinary warmth. No EDM drop, no supersaw, no gated reverb, no choir.
lyrics:
[Intro - pipa, rhythmic]

[Chorus]
麵攤收得比誰都晚
他不等客人 他等鍋涼
涼了才好刷
刷完才好回家

[Verse 1]
塑膠凳疊起來的高度 就是今天的生意
今天疊到第七個
他老婆在後面剝蒜 剝了二十年
手指甲縫裡是洗不掉的白

[Chorus]
麵攤收得比誰都晚
他不等客人 他等鍋涼
涼了才好刷
刷完 天也快亮

[Instrumental Break - pipa and kit]

[Verse 2]
有人來問他加不加盟
他說我這口鍋跟我一樣老
搬到商場裡 湯的味道會變
那人沒聽懂 他也沒再解釋

[Outro - erhu enters, fades]
涼了才好刷
